Build rules for admin and user API headers, objects, and an atomic unit test.

# Purpose
Defines build targets for the `fd_accdb` module. It adds the `fd_accdb_admin.h`, `fd_accdb_user.h`, and `fd_accdb_sync.h` headers, builds the `fd_accdb_admin` and `fd_accdb_user` objects against `fd_flamenco`, and enables the `test_accdb` unit test when `FD_HAS_ATOMIC` is set.
